remarks: This charming Cape Cod-style home is ideally located just a short walk from Greenwich Avenue and the train station. The property features a well-maintained, gated, flat yard. Inside, the home was updated in 2015 with a brand-new kitchen and stylish aesthetic upgrades throughout. The third bedroom/family room includes barn-style French doors, allowing it to function as either a bedroom or an extension of the living room. The second bedroom is tucked away at the back of the house, offering a quiet retreat. The expansive primary suite occupies the entire second floor and features a cozy sitting area, a spacious walk-in closet, additional storage in the eaves, and a large en-suite bathroom. Must see!
